terbaru.judul: Constrained surrogates for arbitrary families of continuous probability distributions
terbaru.pelajaran: Here, we introduce a general framework for constructing constrained surrogates capable of representing arbitrary families of continuous distributions.

terbaru.judul: Physical and emergent nonpairwise interactions in oscillator networks: from higher-order phase reduction to coupling design
terbaru.pelajaran: In this work, we exploit a recently developed parametrization method to compute the phase reduction and answer these questions.

terbaru.judul: The dynamics of early transoceanic voyages: A resource-coupled model of crew health and survival
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a minimal compartmental model describing the voyage itself as a dynamical system coupling crew health and resource depletion.

terbaru.judul: Field closure, ice neurons, and when a dendrite is a motif
Wake interactions drive synchronized vortex merging in a hovering quadcopter
terbaru.pelajaran: The most energetic coherent structure of a hovering full-scale quadcopter is associated with a self-organizing process in which the individual rotor vortices synchronize their frequencies while undergoing merging events, yielding a globally correlated structure.

terbaru.judul: Modelling opinion dynamics during crises as complex contagion with feedback
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a complex contagion with feedback (CCF) model that couples competing complex contagion with crisis dynamics through bidirectional feedback.

terbaru.judul: Why Some Strikes Last Longer: The Resilience Paradox of Partially Functional Institutions
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a minimal dynamical model to investigate how such residual activity affects the persistence of labor conflicts.

terbaru.judul: Message capacity and claim wording set the transition points of collective truth-finding in language-model networks
terbaru.pelajaran: Whether human or large language model (LLM), an agent in a discussion reads only a few of the others' contributions, bounded by cognition, context, or cost.

terbaru.judul: Timbre Analysis of the Hulusi, a Southwestern Chinese Free-Reed Instrument, using Machine Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: In this study, a machine learning model implemented in the COMSAR framework (https://github.com/ifsm) was used to investigate the timbre characteristics of the \emph{hulusi} to cluster different instruments and pitches.

terbaru.judul: A nonlinear hydrodynamic theory of ultrafast laser self-organization
terbaru.pelajaran: Ultrashort laser pulses can induce order out of chaos.
